note: Pre-registered rules for the intra-index regime study. NEVER edit a rule after its freeze date -- a changed rule is a new rule id with its own freeze date. The nightly regime-state build evaluates these against live data and the scoring workflow appends the readings (and, 21 sessions later, realized outcomes) to the regime-scoring-data branch. The forward log is the only evidence that can upgrade the study's in-sample claims.
zone_basis: rolling 504-session percentiles, 30/40/30 split (cz_roll / dz_roll_l1 in intra_index_regime_study.py); DIX zone always on the one-session-lagged signal (FINRA publishes after the close).

ndx_tilt_screen_v1.description: Avoid-screen: while the NDX comovement zone is LowCorr, names in the top 20% of the per-name dark-flow tilt (5d-MA raw dark ratio minus own expanding mean, payload panel) are flagged as avoid. Hypothesis at freeze: flagged names lag the rest of the index over the next 21 sessions (point-in-time in-sample estimate -0.6pp/month, episode CI touching zero).
ndx_tilt_screen_v1.emits: list of flagged tickers, refreshed daily, intended for weekly use
ndx_tilt_screen_v1.outcome: mean 21-session forward return of flagged names minus unflagged NDX names, resolved in batch by the study against the then-current payload (--score-log); the nightly scorer records the names only

ndx_dixlow_caution_v1.description: Caution flag: NDX comovement zone LowCorr AND lag-1 DIX zone DIXLow. Hypothesis at freeze: flagged days run ~2pp/month below the same-period baseline (the corrected study's surviving index-level leg; era-adjusted -2.4pp in-sample).
ndx_dixlow_caution_v1.active_when: NDX cz_roll == LowCorr and NDX dz_roll_l1 == DIXLow
ndx_dixlow_caution_v1.outcome: QQQ 21-session forward return on flagged days vs non-flagged LowCorr days, resolved from the scoring log's own closes

all_dispersed_derisk_v1.description: Risk flag: all three indices' comovement zones LowCorr simultaneously. Hypothesis at freeze: flagged days run below the same-period baseline in all three indices (era-adjusted -1.6 to -2.1pp in-sample; episode CIs include zero -- this rule exists to settle exactly that).
all_dispersed_derisk_v1.active_when: NDX, SPX and IWM cz_roll all == LowCorr
all_dispersed_derisk_v1.outcome: QQQ/SPY/IWM 21-session forward returns on flagged vs non-flagged days, resolved from the scoring log's own closes
